rv.q: And as our hero, Scott Folan is a bespectacled beanpole with a big future. Clever, playful and inventive, he has a terrific stage presence and carries the unpredictable score lightly. There are nicely dotty performances throughout, especially Miracle Chance as Jeremy’s inamorata Christine.
Award-nominated musical, based on the novel by Ned Vizzini is a fun, vibrant and high energy show!
For all its musical hype, this far-fetched musical can get lost in the bright lights, colours, and pulsating projections.
The show still feels a bit flabby in the middle and the story’s resolution is near-laughable, but for all the wrong reasons.
This vibrant, colourful and upbeat production is the quintessential good night out.
Be More Chill is a meaningful commentary on youth culture, but perhaps more importantly, it is just incredibly good fun, and that's just what we all need right now.

cn.t: Critics praise this energetic sci-fi musical about teenage anxiety as a buzzing, eccentric blast of high school delirium, with its whizzy cyber concept and retina-burning visuals delivering fan-favorite entertainment well worth the wait.
